profile.name: Vela_Mirra_Band_336x480
profile.preparation: Passed via official VvdManager with explicit sdkHome and vvdHome

attempts.route: Official launcher with Vela VVD and local Android directory overrides
attempts.result: Exit 1; Unknown VVD name / Unknown AVD name
attempts.notes: The same local ini is visible to -list-avds. Local runtime/vvd and runtime/.vela/vvd aliases plus a child-only USERPROFILE override did not resolve Vela lookup.

attempts.route: Official qemu-system-armel engine with the same local profile
attempts.notes: Initial 0xC0000135 DLL loading failure was traced through PE imports. Supplying the bundled lib64, qt/lib and gles_swiftshader directories only in the child environment resolved DLL loading; Vela profile lookup still failed.

attempts.route: Official out-of-tree recipe with local ANDROID_PRODUCT_OUT, build.prop, explicit kernel/system/data and 336x480 skin
attempts.notes: Both the documented ANDROID_EMULATOR_VELA route and explicit -vela invocation were tried. The application was never loaded.

interpretation: The tested vendor Windows Vela lookup could not be isolated with the available Android directory overrides. Upstream Windows home lookup uses SHGetFolderPathW(CSIDL_PROFILE), which explains why USERPROFILE alone is ineffective; this is an inference from upstream code, not a claim to have the vendor Vela path implementation.
nextRequirement: Resolve a supported isolated native profile route or explicitly authorize a separate SDK setup scope, then verify the built RPK on the engine or target band. No runtime screenshot or touch result is claimed.
